$comment: Money rates for the Costs page (design/ci/health-dashboard.md section 7), with the date each was checked. A missing rate (null) shows NO DATA, never zero. Fixed monthly lines are spread over the days of the month.

t4.$comment: machine.dev T4: minutes rounded up plus one for boot, times the tenancy's rate. Checked 2026-10-25.

llm.$comment: An estimate of CI's Gemini spend, as tools/llm-spend.mjs counts it: a flat 0.94 USD per paid step (measured 2026-10-12 as 194 calls at 0.00485 USD, tmp/ai-cost/report.md; October 2026 averaged 189 calls a release run, 375 for the one bisect point). A paid step is release.yml's LLM regression step, or the test step of a point of a bisect of the llm lane (run name 'Bisect (llm lane)'; legacyBisectRuns lists the one from before the name said so), with a PAID conclusion. Local runs with the same key are not counted. Checked 2026-10-29.

fixedMonthly.$comment: github: Team, 2 seats (checked 2026-10-25). cloudflare: Workers Paid plan (checked 2026-10-25). sentry: plan price not recorded yet.

actionsListPrice.$comment: List-price value of Actions minutes, never money (free for this public repository). Checked 2026-10-25.
